name: Python CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - feature-develop
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Haal de code op
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Stel Python in
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Installeer afhankelijkheden
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then python -m pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
          python -m pip install pytest

      - name: Voer tests uit
        run: pytest -m "not sap_gui"
